title: Why Do Rainbows Appear?
hook: A rainbow is sunlight playing in rain.
narration: A rainbow is sunlight playing in rain.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Rainbows Appear.
Drops bend light and split it into colors.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
You need sun at your back and rain in front.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A rainbow is sunlight playing in rain.
The pictures today are a new rainbow world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do rainbows appear.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
